designer_note: Impact-fused glass from one old strike in the far reach, below the ecliptic. One deposit in the whole system, small reserve, slow recovery: the contested spot that p1-04 combat will inherit. Its name is a lore hook (what fell here?) that archaeology (p2) can pay off; nothing in p1-02 reads that. Every number is a designer assumption; see docs/design/p1-02-mining-design.md.
